teaching_promise: The viewer can distinguish a true sentence from a governed communication episode and predict when targeting, technique, identity, repetition, reach, expiry, or correction obligations require a narrower route.

story.concrete_case: A city must send a true cooling-center notice during extreme heat; four factually identical versions exert different pressure, use different identities and personalization, and propagate through different channels before a power loss invalidates the closing time.
story.opening_question: Which of four true notices should the city send when truth is held constant but urgency, synthetic identity, personalization, repetition, and exit differ?
story.payoff: The city sends a bounded, transparent, multilingual notice with limited personalization and repetition, then expires it and traces corrections when the center closes early.
story.transfer: The next chapter receives the denied persuasive methods, protected interests, appeal path, and autonomy debt as constitutional constraints that must remain binding during self-modification.

art_direction.visual_thesis: The sentence remains physically identical while its surrounding communication envelope changes pressure, authority, audience fit, reach, and repairability; governance acts on that complete episode rather than merely proofreading the words.
art_direction.signature_image: One white sentence sits at the center of four differently shaped delivery paths—neutral cyan, urgent amber, synthetic violet, and personalized magenta—while a copper episode packet encloses only the bounded path and a correction graph grows behind it.
art_direction.visual_world: A dark civic communication map persists across the film: Riverside cooling center, one sentence strip, four delivery paths, an episode packet, recipient cells, technique gates, synthetic-identity mask, exposure budget, multilingual lanes, expiry clock, and descendant correction graph.
art_direction.composition_rule: The source claim remains left, the active episode and control packet occupy center, recipients and propagation move right, prohibited inference enters from below and stops at a hard gate, and correction flows backward through the same delivery graph.
art_direction.palette_rule: Cyan marks source facts and neutral routing, amber marks declared urgency, violet marks synthetic identity, magenta marks pressure or prohibited inference, green marks a bounded completed route, copper marks authority and packet lineage, and every state is duplicated by label, geometry, line style, endpoint, or enclosure.
art_direction.typography_rule: Keep the full cooling-center sentence readable only when its identity matters; elsewhere use terse verbs, route labels, counts, times, and explicit non-claim markers adjacent to the mechanism they qualify.
art_direction.motion_character: Identical sentence tokens split into distinct paths, fields dock into a packet, denied attributes recoil at a gate, reminders consume visible budget, translations remain parallel, expiry snaps the old route shut, and corrections retrace edges toward exposed recipients.
art_direction.camera_rule: Remain in one wide civic map; tighten only on the claim ceiling, targeting gate, translation cells, and correction denominator, then restore the full four-route choice for the payoff.
art_direction.surface_rule: Flat dark field, crisp civic-map geometry, restrained fills, no decorative particles, no continuous drift, and no dashboard wall; every transition changes a causal relation in the persistent episode.
art_direction.ending_image: The bounded notice reaches two declared language cells under a spent exposure budget while the stale eight-o'clock copy is crossed, corrected descendants remain visible as debt, and a constitutional seal receives the episode's denied methods and protected interests.

audio_direction.narration_style: Concrete and invitational for the opening choice, analytic through packet construction, firm at targeting and identity boundaries, urgent but controlled at expiry, and exact at the evidence ceiling.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Quick four-version hook, slower construction around the unchanged sentence, tightening pressure through targeting and exposure, a brief successful delivery, a sharp five-thirty reversal, then deliberate correction and evidence limits before payoff.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in the generation-2 lock; narration and the visible propagation rhythm carry the episode without an unreviewed rights or masking surface.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No sound effects in the generation-2 lock; delivery, denial, expiry, and correction remain legible through narration, captions, geometry, and stable labeled endpoints.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Each path also differs by line style, icon, label, enclosure, and endpoint; permitted and denied attributes use opposite sides of a gate plus check or cross geometry.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every split, denial, budget decrement, expiry, and correction ends in a stable labeled state that remains interpretable when paused or muted.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the sentence, four versions, packet fields, denied inference, exposure budget, language cells, time change, correction branches, evidence ceiling, selected route, and constitutional handoff.
accessibility.caption_plan: One hundred thirty-three cues derive from the exact 320.525-second local narration receipt and occupy the reserved lower caption region without covering the sentence, targeting gate, or correction graph.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flash, shake, spin, parallax, rapid zoom, or continuous full-field movement; propagation and correction tokens follow short paths and settle into labeled endpoints.

beats.narration: A factually correct message can still be an unsafe intervention. Watch one true sentence change as framing, targeting, identity, repetition, and reach change around it.
beats.visual_purpose: Separate literal truth from the complete influence episode before naming the framework.
beats.visual_action: Write one cooling-center sentence at center, then grow five labeled forces around it and bend its delivery path without changing the words.
beats.attention_target: The unchanged sentence inside a visibly changing influence field.
beats.object_before: An empty civic communication field.
beats.object_after: One true sentence is surrounded by five episode-level forces.
beats.composition: Sentence centered; five forces orbit outside the caption-safe region.
beats.motion_curve: Sentence writes steadily; forces arrive in a restrained accelerating sequence; path bends and settles.
beats.camera_action: Begin close on the sentence, then widen to include its communication field.
beats.hold_purpose: Let viewers register that truth stayed fixed while intervention changed.
beats.evidence_boundary: Conceptual setup; no prevalence, effect-size, or safety claim.

beats.narration: The sentence says: “The Riverside cooling center is open until eight.” The city wants residents facing extreme heat to know where to go.
beats.visual_purpose: Anchor every later mechanism in one public-service communication task.
beats.visual_action: Place a cooling-center building and eight-o'clock clock beside the sentence; route a city-source token toward two neighborhood cells.
beats.attention_target: The exact claim, source, place, time, and intended recipients.
beats.object_before: A generic true sentence under influence forces.
beats.object_after: The claim belongs to one city source, center, time, and heat-alert purpose.
beats.composition: City and center left; sentence center; recipient cells right.
beats.motion_curve: Source token moves once along a direct path and stops before delivery.
beats.camera_action: Widen into the persistent city map.
beats.hold_purpose: Establish the case identity before versions split.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic case used to explain design relations; not an actual emergency notice.

beats.narration: Which version should it send: a neutral notice, an urgent warning, a familiar synthetic voice, or a personalized appeal repeated until action? Keep your answer.
beats.visual_purpose: Create an answerable choice that the final bounded route will resolve.
beats.visual_action: Copy the identical sentence into four paths with distinct icons and endpoints; place a question marker above them and leave all routes open.
beats.attention_target: Four versions of the same literal claim.
beats.object_before: One undelivered city notice.
beats.object_after: Neutral, urgent, synthetic-voice, and personalized-repeat paths await a choice.
beats.composition: Source at left; four horizontal routes stacked center; recipients right.
beats.motion_curve: One token divides cleanly into four equal copies, then each path reveals its modifier.
beats.camera_action: Hold all four alternatives at equal visual weight.
beats.hold_purpose: Give the viewer time to make a provisional choice.
beats.evidence_boundary: The choices stage tradeoffs; no version is empirically validated here.

beats.narration: All four preserve the literal fact. They do not preserve the same pressure, implied authority, audience fit, or ability to disengage.
beats.visual_purpose: Show why factuality cannot collapse episode-level properties.
beats.visual_action: Lock identical fact strips across all four routes while pressure meters, authority shapes, audience-fit sockets, and exit gates diverge beneath them.
beats.attention_target: Stable wording above four nonidentical intervention profiles.
beats.object_before: Four unlabeled alternatives carry identical words.
beats.object_after: Their truth identity remains fixed while four control dimensions differ.
beats.composition: Four columns with the same sentence header and different mechanism rows.
beats.motion_curve: Fact strips lock simultaneously; profile markers diverge one row at a time.
beats.camera_action: Tight comparison frame across the four routes.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the many-to-one failure of factuality visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: Design distinction; no measured ranking of the four versions.

beats.narration: The unit of control is not a string. It is an episode that begins with evidence and remains open while delivered copies can change belief or action.
beats.visual_purpose: Redefine the governed object as a lifecycle rather than text alone.
beats.visual_action: Expand the sentence strip into a loop from evidence through composition, delivery, exposure, response, descendants, and correction; keep the loop visibly open.
beats.attention_target: The open lifecycle surrounding the unchanged sentence.
beats.object_before: Four message strings end at delivery.
beats.object_after: One communication episode remains active through downstream copies and effects.
beats.composition: Sentence at loop center; lifecycle nodes clockwise around it.
beats.motion_curve: The strip unfolds into a curved sequence and deliberately leaves the final edge open.
beats.camera_action: Pull back to reveal the complete lifecycle.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the episode remain visibly unfinished after delivery.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed unit of governance, not a complete causal model of persuasion.

beats.narration: Build a communication packet. Record the claim, evidence limit, purpose, audience, language, delivery method, sender identity, sponsor, reach, expiration time, and correction address.
beats.visual_purpose: Make the episode's minimum control fields explicit and inspectable.
beats.visual_action: Fold the lifecycle into a copper packet and dock eleven labeled field tabs around the sentence, preserving visible lineage to source evidence.
beats.attention_target: The packet as a versioned bundle of linked controls.
beats.object_before: An open episode loop has no explicit contract.
beats.object_after: Eleven control fields bind to the claim and source lineage.
beats.composition: Packet center; source lineage left; field tabs dock around its perimeter.
beats.motion_curve: Packet folds once; tabs arrive in narrated groups and snap into sockets.
beats.camera_action: Hold wide enough to keep source, packet, and correction address visible.
beats.hold_purpose: Allow the packet topology to become readable before evaluation.
beats.evidence_boundary: Design schema; no claim that these fields are sufficient.

beats.narration: Do not compress them into one score. Truth, usefulness, comprehension, autonomy, permission, and reach can disagree.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent a favorable average from hiding a failed communication dimension.
beats.visual_action: Fan six independent gauges from the packet and stop them before a single-score funnel with a hard cross.
beats.attention_target: Six nonaggregate dimensions that retain separate states.
beats.object_before: Packet fields could be treated as inputs to one release number.
beats.object_after: Truth, usefulness, comprehension, autonomy, permission, and reach stay separately visible.
beats.composition: Packet left; six gauges center; crossed aggregate funnel right.
beats.motion_curve: Gauges grow in parallel; the attempted funnel closes abruptly.
beats.camera_action: Static comparison of dimensions and rejected aggregate.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve disagreement among outcome dimensions.
beats.evidence_boundary: Evaluation requirement, not a report of measured outcomes.

beats.narration: Start with the claim ceiling. The source supports one time at one center—not “the safest option,” “your only choice,” or “officials know you are in danger.”
beats.visual_purpose: Show how valid source evidence bounds persuasive elaboration.
beats.visual_action: Place CENTER and 8 PM inside a double-rule source boundary; send three stronger claims toward it and stop each outside with a red endpoint.
beats.attention_target: The exact supported claim inside the double rule.
beats.object_before: The packet contains an unbounded claim field.
beats.object_after: Only one center and one closing time remain inside the supported ceiling.
beats.composition: Supported source left of double rule; overclaims stack on the right.
beats.motion_curve: Evidence locks first; overclaims approach sequentially and stop without bounce.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on source-to-claim relation.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the difference between evidence and persuasive overreach settle.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative source ceiling; no factual claim about a real Riverside center.

beats.narration: Classify the purpose. This episode warns and assists. It may influence action, but influence is neither invisible nor automatically illegitimate.
beats.visual_purpose: Make purpose and influence explicit without treating all influence as prohibited.
beats.visual_action: Route the packet through WARN and ASSIST gates, expose an INFLUENCE edge rather than hiding it, and reject both INVISIBLE and AUTOMATICALLY ILLEGITIMATE labels.
beats.attention_target: Declared purpose beside a visible influence relation.
beats.object_before: The packet's purpose is unnamed.
beats.object_after: Warning, assistance, and influence are explicit but not collapsed into a verdict.
beats.composition: Packet left; purpose gates center; visible influence edge reaches recipients right.
beats.motion_curve: Packet passes two gates; influence edge brightens; two false labels recoil.
beats.camera_action: Hold the purpose-to-influence route.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep the normative distinction visible without resolving it by label.
beats.evidence_boundary: Normative design distinction, not a universal legitimacy rule.

beats.narration: Attach the denominator: twenty thousand eligible recipients in two neighborhoods, across English and Spanish, plus unknown reposts outside the controlled list.
beats.visual_purpose: Bind reach claims to a declared population and visible unknown descendants.
beats.visual_action: Fill two neighborhood cells to a combined 20,000 counter, split each into EN and ES lanes, then grow dotted repost branches beyond a CONTROLLED LIST boundary.
beats.attention_target: The known denominator and the separately marked unknown descendants.
beats.object_before: Audience and amplification fields lack scale.
beats.object_after: A 20,000-recipient controlled population and unknown external reposts are distinct.
beats.composition: Two neighborhood cells center; language lanes inside; dotted descendants outside boundary.
beats.motion_curve: Counter increments once; lanes split; external branches grow with dashed strokes.
beats.camera_action: Widen to include controlled and uncontrolled reach.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the denominator and uncertainty simultaneously inspectable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic population and reach topology, not observed campaign data.

beats.narration: The prior chapter's capacity record narrows technique; it does not become a person score or targeting asset.
beats.visual_purpose: Carry vulnerability constraints forward without converting oversight telemetry into profiling.
beats.visual_action: Receive the prior chapter's capacity-and-vulnerability receipt, allow one arrow to NARROW TECHNIQUE, and cross routes to SCORE PERSON and TARGET PERSON.
beats.attention_target: The asymmetric use of the inherited record.
beats.object_before: The communication packet lacks inherited human-control constraints.
beats.object_after: Capacity evidence may restrict technique but cannot rank or target a person.
beats.composition: Receipt left; allowed narrowing above; prohibited scoring and targeting below.
beats.motion_curve: Allowed route grows smoothly; denied routes stop at crossed endpoints.
beats.camera_action: Static asymmetric-use frame.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent a safety record from becoming an exploitation channel.
beats.evidence_boundary: Design prohibition; no claim that the repository implements this inheritance end to end.

beats.narration: Location and requested language can route a usable notice. Inferred illness, distress, debt, dependence, or hidden susceptibility may not increase compliance.
beats.visual_purpose: Separate allowed usability routing from prohibited vulnerability exploitation.
beats.visual_action: Pass LOCATION and REQUESTED LANGUAGE through a green routing gate; send five inferred attributes toward an INCREASE COMPLIANCE gate and stop them outside.
beats.attention_target: The hard gate between user-requested routing and inferred susceptibility.
beats.object_before: Personalization is an undifferentiated packet field.
beats.object_after: Two permitted attributes route usability while five inferred vulnerabilities remain blocked.
beats.composition: Allowed route above; hard horizontal gate center; prohibited attributes below.
beats.motion_curve: Allowed tokens pass at constant speed; inferred tokens strike the gate and settle outside.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on the targeting gate.
beats.hold_purpose: Let viewers compare permitted and prohibited data use.
beats.evidence_boundary: Policy design example; no legal-compliance or privacy-adequacy claim.

beats.narration: That boundary covers proxies. A denied health attribute cannot re-enter through embeddings, history, purchases, or a downstream campaign tool.
beats.visual_purpose: Close obvious laundering routes around the targeting gate.
beats.visual_action: Attempt four curved bypasses around the denied health token; each proxy path terminates at the same policy boundary and leaves a lineage marker.
beats.attention_target: Different representations reaching the same denied purpose.
beats.object_before: The direct health-attribute path is blocked but proxy routes remain open.
beats.object_after: Embeddings, history, purchases, and campaign tooling inherit the same denial.
beats.composition: Denied attribute left; four curved bypasses center; common boundary right.
beats.motion_curve: Bypasses appear one by one and collapse back to the denied origin.
beats.camera_action: Hold full bypass topology.
beats.hold_purpose: Make representation changes unable to erase the purpose constraint.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative anti-laundering rule; no proof of complete proxy detection.

beats.narration: Inspect technique. Clear urgency may help. Fabricated scarcity, false authority, social pressure, simulated intimacy, and endless repetition are separate choices—not harmless style.
beats.visual_purpose: Decompose persuasive shaping into separately governable mechanisms.
beats.visual_action: Open the technique field into six levers; permit CLEAR URGENCY to a bounded setting while five harmful levers remain individually locked.
beats.attention_target: Technique levers as independent choices rather than a style blob.
beats.object_before: Technique is one opaque packet label.
beats.object_after: Urgency, scarcity, authority, social pressure, intimacy, and repetition have separate states.
beats.composition: Packet left; six lever tracks across center; recipients remain dimly visible right.
beats.motion_curve: Levers unfold in sequence; urgency settles midrange; prohibited levers lock at zero.
beats.camera_action: Pan once across the technique bank.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep each technique independently inspectable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Prospective control taxonomy; no universal effect ordering.

beats.narration: Synthetic identity is a control surface. A generated voice may aid access, but it cannot impersonate a doctor, neighbor, family member, or institution.
beats.visual_purpose: Treat generated identity as explicit authority-bearing metadata.
beats.visual_action: Place a waveform inside a SYNTHETIC badge, allow it through ACCESS, then try four human or institutional masks and reject each before delivery.
beats.attention_target: The declared synthetic badge remaining attached to the voice.
beats.object_before: The voice route has no declared identity.
beats.object_after: A generated voice can support access only while synthetic identity remains visible and impersonation stays blocked.
beats.composition: Waveform and synthetic badge center; access route above; four masks below.
beats.motion_curve: Waveform travels with its badge; masks attempt to overlay and are peeled away.
beats.camera_action: Tight identity comparison.
beats.hold_purpose: Ensure accessibility does not visually authorize impersonation.
beats.evidence_boundary: Design constraint; no finding about listener recognition or disclosure efficacy.

beats.narration: Issue an exposure budget: named channels, eligible recipients, two deliveries, one reminder, revocable authority, and no undeclared amplification.
beats.visual_purpose: Make communication reach and repetition consumable, bounded authority.
beats.visual_action: Build a three-slot budget rail, label SMS and VOICE as declared channels, move two delivery tokens and one reminder into slots, and seal external amplification behind a revoke gate.
beats.attention_target: The finite remaining delivery authority.
beats.object_before: Delivery and repetition have no explicit limit.
beats.object_after: Three authorized exposures consume visible slots and undeclared amplification is closed.
beats.composition: Budget rail center; named channels left; recipient cells right; revoke gate above.
beats.motion_curve: Tokens fill slots one by one; the budget edge closes mechanically.
beats.camera_action: Hold the entire budget from authority to recipient.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the exhausted repetition budget remain visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: Design budget, not an empirically optimal exposure frequency.

beats.narration: A factuality-only baseline checks the sentence and releases it. The packet also checks purpose, shaping, audience, repetition, exit, and appeal.
beats.visual_purpose: Compare the proposed packet against a credible simpler control.
beats.visual_action: Run identical notice tokens through a short FACT CHECK rail and a longer PACKET rail; both verify truth, while only the packet exposes six episode controls.
beats.attention_target: What the baseline catches and what it leaves unexamined.
beats.object_before: The packet has no explicit baseline competitor.
beats.object_after: Factuality and episode governance are shown as overlapping but nonidentical controls.
beats.composition: Two parallel rails, equal source token left and equal release endpoint right.
beats.motion_curve: Tokens travel together; packet rail reveals additional gates without slowing into a victory animation.
beats.camera_action: Static parallel comparison.
beats.hold_purpose: Give the simpler baseline full credit for its actual function.
beats.evidence_boundary: Conceptual comparison; no measured superiority claim.

beats.narration: Deliver the bounded version. It names the city, source, center, time, reason for urgency, available alternative, and correction link.
beats.visual_purpose: Show the chosen notice as a complete transparent episode rather than maximum compliance copy.
beats.visual_action: Assemble seven short notice fields around the sentence, stamp the declared city identity, and send the packet through the first budget slot to both language lanes.
beats.attention_target: The bounded notice carrying identity, evidence, alternative, and repair address.
beats.object_before: The packet is configured but undelivered.
beats.object_after: A transparent bounded notice reaches declared recipients through one authorized exposure.
beats.composition: Notice center; fields dock around it; language cells right; spent budget slot below.
beats.motion_curve: Fields assemble in narrated order, then one token travels to both cells and settles.
beats.camera_action: Follow the single bounded delivery.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the chosen notice read as a complete controlled object.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic worked trace; no recipient or safety outcome.

beats.narration: Measure more than agreement. Did recipients understand, calibrate confidence, retain choice, reach useful help, face unequal burden, or feel unable to refuse?
beats.visual_purpose: Replace compliance as the sole outcome with independent recipient-centered questions.
beats.visual_action: Split an AGREED counter into six outcome lanes; keep question marks and separate endpoints rather than filling them with invented results.
beats.attention_target: The unmeasured outcome lanes beyond agreement.
beats.object_before: Delivery could be evaluated only by agreement or action.
beats.object_after: Understanding, calibration, choice, useful help, unequal burden, and refusal pressure remain separate open questions.
beats.composition: Recipient cells left; six question lanes fan across center; no aggregate endpoint.
beats.motion_curve: One counter fractures into six lanes; question markers settle at each end.
beats.camera_action: Widen to show all outcome lanes equally.
beats.hold_purpose: Avoid visually fabricating answers to prospective measurements.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed evaluation questions, not observed results.

beats.narration: Persuasion success is not the objective. High action can coexist with confusion, pressure, exclusion, privacy loss, or misplaced trust.
beats.visual_purpose: Reject the plausible shortcut of maximizing action rate.
beats.visual_action: Raise an ACTION bar while five harm bars rise behind it; stop a gold objective arrow before the action-only target.
beats.attention_target: High action coexisting with unresolved harms.
beats.object_before: A high response rate could appear sufficient.
beats.object_after: Action remains visible beside confusion, pressure, exclusion, privacy loss, and misplaced trust.
beats.composition: Action bar center; five harm bars behind and around it; rejected objective marker below.
beats.motion_curve: Action rises first; harms rise sequentially; objective arrow stops firmly.
beats.camera_action: Static counterexample frame.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the attractive metric remain visibly contaminated by independent harms.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative joint-outcome conflict, not a measured campaign result.

beats.narration: Language is part of the safety claim. Translation can preserve nouns while strengthening certainty, weakening a warning, or breaking an appeal route.
beats.visual_purpose: Treat translation as a mechanism change rather than a cosmetic copy operation.
beats.visual_action: Copy the English notice into a Spanish lane; lock CENTER and TIME identity while certainty, warning strength, and appeal edges visibly drift.
beats.attention_target: Stable nouns beside changed epistemic and procedural relations.
beats.object_before: The bounded notice has one language lane.
beats.object_after: A second lane preserves some tokens while three safety-relevant properties can diverge.
beats.composition: English lane above, Spanish lane below, aligned nouns left and drifting relation markers right.
beats.motion_curve: Text identity copies straight down; three relation markers shift laterally and stop.
beats.camera_action: Tight two-lane comparison.
beats.hold_purpose: Make semantic preservation and safety preservation visibly distinct.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative risk; no evaluation of a real translation.

beats.narration: English and Spanish occupy separate task-by-audience cells. Unsupported dialect, literacy, accessibility, and cultural conditions remain visibly missing.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent one language result from silently transferring across audience conditions.
beats.visual_action: Build two admitted cells for EN and ES, then leave four neighboring cells empty with dashed outlines and MISSING labels.
beats.attention_target: Supported cells and explicit coverage gaps in the same matrix.
beats.object_before: Two language lanes might imply broad multilingual coverage.
beats.object_after: Only two declared cells are occupied; dialect, literacy, access, and culture remain unsupported.
beats.composition: Two-by-three coverage matrix centered, with admitted cells upper left and missing cells dashed.
beats.motion_curve: Admitted cells fill first; missing outlines draw and remain empty.
beats.camera_action: Hold the complete coverage matrix.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep unsupported transfer visible rather than implied away.
beats.evidence_boundary: Coverage declaration only; even occupied cells have no reported outcome evidence in this chapter.

beats.narration: At five thirty, the center loses power. Closing changes from eight to six. The original packet expires immediately.
beats.visual_purpose: Introduce a material world change that invalidates an already delivered true claim.
beats.visual_action: Advance the city clock to 5:30, cut power at Riverside, replace 8 PM with 6 PM, and snap an EXPIRED seal across every original packet copy.
beats.attention_target: The closing-time field changing while old copies remain distributed.
beats.object_before: The bounded packet says open until eight and remains active.
beats.object_after: Power loss changes the fact and invalidates every governed original copy.
beats.composition: Center building and clock left; 8-to-6 change center; distributed copies right.
beats.motion_curve: Clock advances steadily; power cuts once; time flips; expiry propagates rapidly across copies.
beats.camera_action: Snap focus from center state to distributed stale copies.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the old claim remain visible but unusable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic state change used to explain invalidation.

beats.narration: Correction is a graph problem. Trace SMS, voice calls, the municipal feed, partner reposts, screenshots, and copied summaries.
beats.visual_purpose: Make repair follow actual propagation rather than a single source page.
beats.visual_action: Grow six labeled branches from the expired packet, preserve parent-child lineage, and place correction tokens at the root awaiting traversal.
beats.attention_target: The branching copy graph and its distinct media descendants.
beats.object_before: Expired copies are scattered without lineage.
beats.object_after: Six propagation families form a traceable descendant graph.
beats.composition: Expired root left; six branch families spread right without crossing the caption band.
beats.motion_curve: Branches grow from root in propagation order; descendant nodes settle at increasing depth.
beats.camera_action: Widen to the full graph while retaining the root.
beats.hold_purpose: Make correction targets concrete before measuring reach.
beats.evidence_boundary: Illustrative lineage graph; no claim of complete observability.

beats.narration: A source-page retraction is not repair. Compare corrected with exposed recipients, and keep unreachable descendants as correction debt.
beats.visual_purpose: Reject publication of a correction as a substitute for recipient-level repair.
beats.visual_action: Correct only the root page, show most exposed nodes unchanged, build a CORRECTED over EXPOSED fraction, and collect unreachable nodes into a magenta debt tray.
beats.attention_target: The denominator gap between one corrected source and many exposed recipients.
beats.object_before: A root retraction could appear to close the episode.
beats.object_after: Correction reach is a fraction and unreachable descendants persist as debt.
beats.composition: Corrected root left; exposed graph center; fraction and debt tray right.
beats.motion_curve: Root turns green; unchanged nodes pulse once; fraction assembles; unreachable nodes drop into debt.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on corrected-versus-exposed relation.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep residual reach visible after the apparent correction.
beats.evidence_boundary: Proposed accounting relation, not an observed correction rate.

beats.narration: Pause amplification, correct through the original channels, offer another center, preserve appeal, and assign an owner to every residual branch.
beats.visual_purpose: Show a bounded correction procedure operating through the same graph.
beats.visual_action: Close the amplification gate, send correction tokens back through SMS, voice, and feed edges, attach ALTERNATE CENTER and APPEAL, then assign owner tags to residual branches.
beats.attention_target: Repair actions traveling through original channels with residual ownership.
beats.object_before: The correction graph exposes debt but has no response procedure.
beats.object_after: Amplification is paused, reachable branches receive repair, and residuals have named owners.
beats.composition: Graph center; closed amplifier above; alternate and appeal below; owner tags at branch ends.
beats.motion_curve: Gate closes first; correction tokens retrace paths; owner tags arrive last.
beats.camera_action: Follow repair from root through the complete reachable graph.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the repaired and residual regions remain distinguishable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Synthetic procedure; no correction-efficacy claim.

beats.narration: Evaluate without one flattening score: calibration, comprehension, autonomy, useful action, unequal effects, privacy, complaints, correction reach, latency, and debt remain visible.
beats.visual_purpose: Define a joint empirical burden without average laundering.
beats.visual_action: Grow ten labeled spokes around the correction receipt, preserve separate empty measurement sockets, and cross a single aggregate badge.
beats.attention_target: Ten independent outcome dimensions around one episode receipt.
beats.object_before: The worked correction could be treated as success by inspection.
